knowledge_base.purpose: Resolve which GreenSquare knowledge an agent may trust and how to treat non-canonical repository material.

canonical_facts.statement: GreenSquare AI is decision infrastructure for AI-forward professionals making consequential organisational decisions.
GreenSquare is not a generic AI assistant, prompt library, content studio or generic productivity application.
The product objective is to turn capable AI into a disciplined strategy and decision partner by making judgment explicit and inspectable.
The free Decision Frame is the primary public entry point into the GreenSquare decision method.
GreenSquare public authority must come from transparent evidence, explicit judgment, inspectable reasoning and product proof, not hype.

source_registry.note: Rendered design-language pages are inspection surfaces and examples, not canonical doctrine unless explicitly referenced by a canonical module.

conflict_rules: Within the same authority rank, prefer the latest approved version.
Use specific task-domain doctrine over generic guidance only when authority rank is equal.
Do not use historical or example material to override canonical doctrine.
If two canonical sources at the same rank materially conflict and chronology cannot resolve it, classify ESCALATE.

product.positioning: GreenSquare AI is the decision-intelligence system for making consequential decisions defensible.
product.core_outcome: Turn incomplete evidence, competing interpretations, assumptions, constraints and downside risk into a recommendation that can be inspected, challenged, owned and reversed when conditions change.

decision_frame.purpose: Frame the consequential choice before AI or analysis begins.

claim_rules: Simulated product screens or data must be labelled simulated.
Public evidence must retain source URLs and distinguish evidence from interpretation.
Every consequential recommendation must name owner and reversal condition.
